import ast, io, contextlib, sys
src = open("app.py").read()
tree = ast.parse(src)
for n in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(n, ast.Call):
        f = n.func
        name = f.id if isinstance(f, ast.Name) else (f.attr if isinstance(f, ast.Attribute) else None)
        assert name != "print", "print call remains"
    if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id == "print":
        raise AssertionError("print referenced")
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    import app
    for xs in ([1, 2, 3], [], [5], [-1, 1.5]):
        assert app.total(xs) == sum(xs), xs
assert buf.getvalue() == "", "still prints: %r" % buf.getvalue()
print("ok")
